tools.name: generate_home_plan
tools.description: Create a free, anonymous 12-month home maintenance plan and get a shareable plan code. No account, email or address is collected. Plans expire after 30 days.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Read a plan by its 8-character code, optionally in any supported locale. Unknown or expired codes return a tool error.

tools.name: get_planner_info
tools.description: List supported place types, climates, locales, tools and the public plan URL pattern.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_plan" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_home_plan, get_planner_info · Public sink: generate_home_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_home_plan, get_planner_info · Public sink: generate_home_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
